sections.title: Overview
sections.text: Compressor stations raise pipeline pressure to keep gas moving across the network. We deliver the station complete — compression package, process piping, utilities and the control and safety system — engineered, built and commissioned as one scope.

rows.label: Application
rows.value: Pipeline pressure boosting on transmission and distribution networks

rows.label: Scope
rows.value: Compression package, process & utility piping, E&I and controls, civil works

rows.label: Controls
rows.value: Unit control panel integrated with station DCS/PLC and ESD

rows.label: Delivery
rows.value: Turnkey — engineered, constructed and commissioned by one team

sections.title: Availability is the whole point
sections.text: A compressor station earns its keep only when it runs. We design for reliable control, safe shutdown and maintainability, and we stay to support it.
